product_overview: A modular ERP backend platform providing security, organization master data, master data lookups, notifications, and file services. The system supports JWT-based authentication, role- and permission-driven access, hierarchical org structures, secure file token workflows, and channel-based notifications.
core_goals: Provide secure authentication, authorization, and user management
Support hierarchical organization master data and scoped data access
Enable admin management of pages, permissions, roles, and menus
Offer configurable master data lookup tables for cross-module reuse
Deliver secure file upload/download/delete flows using time-limited tokens
Support notification sending, templates, channel configuration, and inbox/history tracking

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Allows users to log in, refresh and revoke tokens, self-register, activate accounts, and request password resets.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid username and password -> Receive 200 with accessToken and expiresIn -> Use token for authenticated API calls -> Receive 200 from protected endpoints
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401/400 error response with success=false and error details
POST /api/auth/refresh with valid refresh-token HttpOnly cookie -> Receive 200 with new accessToken and expiresIn -> Continue calling protected endpoints
POST /api/auth/logout with an active refresh token -> Receive 204 No Content -> Reusing the old refresh token fails on /api/auth/refresh

POST /api/auth/signup with valid username, email, and password -> Receive 200 with signup confirmation while account remains disabled -> POST /api/auth/signup/activate with valid activation token -> Receive 200 OK

POST /api/auth/forgot-password with an unknown email -> Receive 200 OK generic response without revealing account existence -> POST /api/auth/reset-password with invalid or expired token -> Receive error response
POST /api/auth/reset-password with valid token and new password -> Receive 200 OK -> POST /api/auth/login with the new password -> Receive 200 with accessToken

features.name: Menu
features.description: Returns the current user's navigation tree filtered by VIEW permissions, and allows admins to inspect another user's menu.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access token -> GET /api/menu/user-menu with JWT bearer token -> Receive 200 with MenuItemDto[] for the current user
POST /api/auth/login with a low-privilege user -> Receive 200 with access token -> GET /api/menu/user-menu with JWT bearer token -> Receive 200 with a reduced menu tree based on VIEW permission
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access token -> GET /api/menu/user-menu/{userId} as an admin -> Receive 200 with MenuItemDto[] for the specified user
GET /api/menu/user-menu without a JWT bearer token -> Receive 401/403 error response with success=false

features.name: Pages
features.description: Manages application pages/screens and auto-generates CRUD permissions for each created page.
user_flows: POST /api/pages with valid pageCode, names, route, module, and active=true -> Receive 201/200 with PageResponse -> Verify auto-generated VIEW, CREATE, UPDATE, and DELETE permissions exist for the page
POST /api/pages/search with filters for pageCode, module, or active status -> Receive 200 with paginated Page<PageResponse> results
GET /api/pages/active with a valid JWT token -> Receive 200 with PageResponse[] for dropdown use
PUT /api/pages/{id} with updated metadata but unchanged pageCode -> Receive 200 with updated PageResponse
PUT /api/pages/{id}/deactivate for an in-use page -> Receive 200 with deactivated PageResponse
PUT /api/pages/{id}/reactivate after deactivation -> Receive 200 with reactivated PageResponse
POST /api/pages with missing required fields or duplicate pageCode -> Receive error response with validation or conflict details

features.name: Permissions
features.description: Creates and updates granular permissions attached to pages and permission types.
user_flows: POST /api/permissions with a valid name, pageId, and permissionType -> Receive 201/200 with PermissionDto -> Use returned permission in role-page assignment flows
POST /api/permissions/search with module or name filters -> Receive 200 with paginated Page<PermissionDto> results
PUT /api/permissions/{id} with valid updated values -> Receive 200 with updated PermissionDto
POST /api/permissions with an invalid pageId or duplicate permission definition -> Receive error response with success=false and error details
PUT /api/permissions/{id} for a non-existent permission -> Receive 404/400-style error response

features.name: Roles
features.description: Creates and manages roles, activates or deactivates them, and manages page-permission assignments and copying.
user_flows: POST /api/roles with valid roleCode, roleName, description, and active flag -> Receive 201/200 with RoleDto -> GET /api/roles/{roleId} returns the created role
POST /api/roles/search with roleName filter -> Receive 200 with paginated RoleDto results
PUT /api/roles/{roleId} with updated roleName or description -> Receive 200 with updated RoleDto while roleCode remains immutable
GET /api/roles/{roleId}/pages -> Receive 200 with RolePagesMatrixResponse showing assigned page CRUD permissions
POST /api/roles/{roleId}/pages with pageCode and permissions -> Receive 201/200 with PageAssignmentResponse -> GET /api/roles/{roleId}/pages shows VIEW added automatically
PUT /api/roles/{roleId}/pages with a full replacement matrix -> Receive 200 with RolePagesMatrixResponse reflecting the replacement
POST /api/roles/{roleId}/copy-from/{sourceRoleId} -> Receive 200 with CopyPermissionsResponse -> GET /api/roles/{roleId}/pages reflects copied page-scoped permissions
DELETE /api/roles/{roleId} for a role still referenced by users or assignments -> Receive 409 conflict with role-in-use details
PUT /api/roles/{roleId}/activate or /deactivate -> Receive 200 with updated RoleDto
POST /api/roles with duplicate roleCode or invalid payload -> Receive error response with validation or conflict details

GET /api/v1/security/role-branches -> Receive 200 with paginated Page<SecRoleBranchDto> results

user_flows: POST /api/v1/files/upload-token with valid ownerId, ownerType, moduleCode, and fileCategoryFk -> Receive 201/200 with encryptedToken and expiresAt -> POST /upload/{encryptedToken} with multipart file bytes -> Receive 201/200 with fileDocumentPk and file metadata

POST /api/v1/files/{fileDocumentPk}/access-token?action=delete with a valid JWT token -> Receive 201/200 with encryptedToken and expiresAt -> DELETE /{encryptedToken} -> Receive 200 with FileDeleteConfirmation

POST /api/v1/files/upload-token with missing owner or fileCategory data -> Receive error response with validation details

code_summary.response_envelope_note: IMPORTANT: every endpoint response is wrapped in a shared ApiResponse envelope: {correlationId: string, message: string, success: boolean, timestamp: string, data: <payload below>} for 2xx responses, or {correlationId: string, message: string, success: false, timestamp: string, error: {code, details, path, timestamp}} for error responses. The 'data'/'error' schemas below describe the INNER payload only — e.g. a 200 documented as 'UserDto' actually arrives as response.json()['data'], NOT response.json() directly. Exceptions: 204 No Content has no body, and the raw file-bytes download endpoint returns unwrapped binary content.
